decisions.reason: Adding rows to the Payment and Milestone Schedule table does not change the requirement to include a table of contents.
The schedule-table revision does not affect the number, location, or integration method of team biographies.
The source changes a supplied proposal table, not the inclusion requirements for narrative sections or subsections.
The Payment and Milestone Schedule revision does not change the proposal letter's one-page layout or signature-insertion behavior.
Adding rows to a schedule table does not change how the organization chart must be incorporated.
The source modifies rows within one table and does not authorize or require any change to the fixed section sequence.
Although additional table rows may consume space, the source does not change the page-count target, compaction strategy, or compliance goal.
The table-content revision remains covered by the existing full-document layout obligation and does not change its layout approach, coverage, or pass count.
The schedule-table revision does not change any photo inclusion, selection, or placement requirement.
A revision to the current proposal's schedule table does not resume or modify the deferred reusable-template requirement.
Adding rows to the Payment and Milestone Schedule table does not change the selected brand identity, colors, or logo source.
The source does not add, remove, or alter hyperlink requirements and provides no evidence that the table revision affects link functionality.
